title: Richmond Rent Control 2026: What Landlords Must Know About the Richmond Fair Rent Act

findings.quote: MAR = Base Rent + every lawful AGA applied since, via the city's MAR calculator
findings.root_cause: Partial fix: an additive percentage equation remains, and the named calculator has no link.
findings.fix: Remove the equation. Describe MAR as dependent on lawful rent history and applicable adjustments, and link the actual city calculator from https://www.ci.richmond.ca.us/3376/Rent-Increase.
findings.future_prevention: Verify the current source and every repeated instance before closing the finding.

findings.quote: More notice than the minimum is always safe; less is not.
findings.root_cause: Cumulative timing and mailing time are corrected, but the new absolute assurance exceeds what section 827 establishes.
findings.fix: Delete this sentence or say that longer notice does not cure an unlawful increase or defective service. Source: https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=827.
findings.future_prevention: Verify the current source and every repeated instance before closing the finding.

findings.quote: applying Oakland's higher rate to a Richmond unit is an overcharge
findings.root_cause: Unqualified claim conflicts with the article's own eligible-banking exception, which can permit more than 1.5%.
findings.fix: Qualify: 'Applying 2.3% without sufficient lawful banking or another authorized basis can produce an unlawful increase.' Source: https://www.ci.richmond.ca.us/3376/Rent-Increase.
findings.future_prevention: Verify the current source and every repeated instance before closing the finding.
